definitions.deity: a god or goddess (especially in a polytheistic religion).
definitions.depository: a place where things are stored.
definitions.destroy: put an end to the existence of (something) by damaging or attacking it.
definitions.dirty: covered or marked with a substance that causes a mark, stain, or contamination; not clean.
definitions.dopey: stupefied by sleep or a drug.
definitions.dropsy: an abnormal accumulation of fluid in the body's tissues; oedema.
definitions.osprey: a large fish-eating bird of prey with long, narrow wings and a white underside and crown.
definitions.oyster: a bivalve marine mollusc with a rough, flattened, irregularly oval shell, several kinds of which are farmed for food or pearls.
definitions.piety: the quality of being pious or reverent.
definitions.pity: a feeling of sorrow and compassion caused by the sufferings of others.
definitions.poetry: poems collectively or as a genre of literature.
definitions.prey: an animal hunted and killed by another for food.
definitions.prosody: the patterns of rhythm and sound used in poetry.
definitions.pyre: a heap of combustible material, especially one for burning a corpse as part of a funeral ceremony.
definitions.rosy: (especially of a person's skin) rose-red or pink, typically as an indication of health or youthfulness.
definitions.sooty: covered with or coloured like soot.
definitions.spidery: resembling a spider, especially in having long, thin, angular lines like a spider's legs.
definitions.sporty: fond of or good at sport.
definitions.storey: a part of a building comprising all the rooms that are on the same level.
definitions.story: an account of imaginary or real people and events told for entertainment.
definitions.troy: a system of weights used mainly for precious metals and gems, with a pound of 12 ounces or 5,760 grains.
definitions.type: a category of people or things having common characteristics.
definitions.tyre: a rubber covering, typically inflated or surrounding an inflated inner tube, placed round a wheel to form a soft contact with the road.
definitions.yeti: a large hairy manlike creature said to live in the highest part of the Himalayas.
definitions.yore: (of yore) of former times or long ago.
